title: SystemMetadata
description: SAIA-Class S system metadata envelope providing universal metadata fields for all Beast System 3.0 components.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema used by this object (semantic or sovereign revision code).

systemVersion.description: Version of Beast System 3.0 that produced this object.

component.description: Name of the subsystem that produced this object (governance-kernel, wellbeing-engine, predictive-engine, registry-service, doctrine-compiler, etc.).

origin.description: Origin of the object (system, actor, automated-process, external-source).

traceId.description: Trace identifier for linking related operations across subsystems.

requestId.description: Optional request identifier for correlating user or system requests.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this object was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this object was last updated.

tags.description: Optional classification tags for filtering, grouping, or indexing.
